method: For each of the two marked Q1920 local images, form the exact six-generator seam presentation P, its canonical epimorphism to Q/V=A5, and the index-60 kernel N. Compute N_ab by Reidemeister-Schreier and independently compute H_1(N,F_2) as the cellular homology of the 60-sheeted presentation cover.
consequence: N_ab is the direct sum of the injected five-dimensional Q-module V and a four-dimensional A5-submodule generated by c. The images of V and V^c coincide, z lies in [N,N], and c does not.
scope: This determines the first homology of the universal Q1920 seam kernel. It does not determine whether N or P is finite, the subgroup V intersect V^c inside P, or the full nonabelian kernel structure.
